name: Arcane Shield Defense
body:
Prerequisite(s): Shield proficiency

Benefit(s): The magus may expend one point from her arcane pool as a swift action to add her shield bonus to her reflex saves against area of effect spells. This includes any enhancement bonus applied to the shield.
